description:
A notoriously Ottoman playstyle with large army size makes it possible to push and finish the game in feudal, but also to win with a tech advantage. 

See video for references. This is a difficult playstyle. 
Base layout is explained in video. 
Check BO below for additional information.
name: Full 'Standard Ottoman' Guide with Matchups and Guidance for lategame
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Send 5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to gather 50 @resource/resource_stone.png@ after, send them to gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@, then go to @resource/sheep.png@

1 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ builds a @building_economy/house.png@(non obstructively with @building_technology/blacksmith.png@-layout and @landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.png@-placement, preferrably corner towards woodline) then goes to @resource/sheep.png@
Split according to macro tab. Gather @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ first then go later to woodline and build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@

Build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ then @building_military/stable.png@ then 2nd @building_ottomans/military-school-1.png@ then @building_military/archery-range.png@ (new buildings after that are game dependent)
Start queuing @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@ from @building_military/stable.png@ and begin building mass

Vizier point order: 1st: @technology_ottomans/anatolian-hills-1.webp@ -> 2nd: @technology_ottomans/military-campus-1.png@ -> 3rd/4th: @technology_ottomans/fast-training-1.png@ for longer game / @technology_ottomans/janissary-company-1.png@ for game ending push against cavalry-based compostion. 4th/5th: @technology_ottomans/advanced-academy-1.png@ for Lategame Janissary Production. Knights work as well.

This marks the end of the build order. At some point, you can either go for a full feudal push, or hit a castle timing with 3-4 @building_military/barracks.png@up to build @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@.

For @age/age_3.png@: your composition is still @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.png@ @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@with upgrades, but now make @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@/@unit_cavalry/lancer-3.png@ and @building_military/siege-workshop.png@.
This build works against all but @civilization_flag/rus.png@and @civilization_flag/eng.png@where you instead go straight to feudal with" 6 on food/2 on gold -> rest to food" opening for fast ageup.
Against @civilization_flag/mal.png@, open @building_military/barracks.png@ in dark age and burn down pit mine then houses (in that order)

Vs @civilization_flag/mon.png@, open @building_ottomans/military-school-1.png@ -> @building_military/barracks.png@ and produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@with @technology_ottomans/field-work-1.png@ and try to burn down 'Ovoo' if possible

description: The standard way of playing Ottomans. Early spears good for pressuring enemy resources early or push deer to your base.
name: Military School Feudal Standard Build (S9)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to gather 50@resource/resource_stone.png@ (long distance gather) & 1 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ to build a @building_economy/house.png@
Drop off 50 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ then go @resource/resource_food.png@

Remacro time: Take @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@. Pull 5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@
Gather another 100 stone then pull off to wood. You want the extra 100 for @technology_ottomans/military-campus-1.webp@
End of build order. Decide now if you want to continue to build army or go castle and grab relics and get 2nd tc / timing attack. Up to you to make these decisions :)

description:
2TC Ottoman Beasty guide (February 2024)
- Can be play +- vs any civ

Matchups:
- English - hardest - they push too fast with LB and military school produces spearman 
- Zhu Xi and China - rough
name: 2TC Ottoman
author: Swing

notes: Goal is to get 50 stone mined (=1 run without building mining camp -> enough stone for military school)
Move 5@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@@resource/resource_stone.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ (until 50 wood = with 5 villagers it means 1 run)

Move 2 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@@resource/sheep.png@@resource/resource_food.png@ to build @building_ottomans/military-school-1.png@ (build military buildings in back of your base to not lose it if pushed)
Wood villagers are then moved to food, workers that were building military school too and one of them builds house

When military school is finished -> 1@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ from @building_ottomans/military-school-1.png@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ (do not build house where you are going to build military buildings so they are in blacksmith bonus range)
1@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ from @building_economy/house.png@ goes to @resource/sheep.png@@resource/resource_food.png@ (so there will be 9 vills on food)
Change TC rally point to @resource/resource_gold.png@ until 3@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@
Our target at this stage is to have 9 food and 3 gold vills
Rally TC to food until age up
- Build Twin Minaret right next to TC but not too close to berries, so workers on Minaret are not in rage of berries
- Do not build it in the place where you will place military buildings

When @technology_economy/horticulture.png@ researched, reduce it to 4@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@, when @technology_economy/fertilization.png@ researched, reduce them to 3@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ or just keep 4 all the time to make it easier
During age up, move 4@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@@resource/sheep.png@@resource/resource_food.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ and build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
1@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@@resource/resource_wood.png@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ then moves to build @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ at @resource/resource_stone.png@
5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ from age up stay on@landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.png@ (see more above about villagers on Minaret)
350 stone is for 2TC and 300 is for military schools
Workers that were building 2TC go to @resource/resource_gold.png@
Target at this stage is to have 8 on wood, 8 on gold and rest on food with TC rally point to food
- We can age up to Castle (with 8 villagers)
- barracks, archer ranges and MAA (we do not want to produce janissaries until enemy has cavalry)
- if opponent has cavalry we want to age up and get janissaries
With first @age/vizier_point.webp@ we get sheeps, so we can place 2TC on gold because we have safe food
With second @age/vizier_point.png@ we get +1 military schools
@civilization_flag/eng.webp@ Do not go military school that soon if you play against English and instead age up quicker
@civilization_flag/rus.png@ If against Rus - you can kill him some wolfs with spearman to deny bounty
@civilization_flag/fre.png@@civilization_flag/jda.png@ Be annoying at their gold with spearman
@civilization_flag/abb.png@ Be annoying at gold and stone
- When we age up, we make barracks and upgrade spearman to defend
5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to gather 50@resource/resource_stone.webp@ (long distance gather) & 1 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ to build a @building_economy/house.webp@
Drop off 50 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ then go @resource/resource_food.webp@

Remacro time: Take @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@. Pull 5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@
Gather another 100 stone then pull off to wood. You want the extra 100 for @technology_ottomans/military-campus-1.webp@
End of build order. Decide now if you want to continue to build army or go castle and grab relics and get 2nd tc / timing attack. Up to you to make these decisions :)
1 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@->@abilities/repair.webp@@building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ next to TC , then back to @resource/sheep.webp@

@age/vizier_point.webp@->@technology_ottomans/anatolian-hills-1.webp@/@technology_ottomans/field-work-1.webp@ (@technology_ottomans/anatolian-hills-1.webp@ easier to play, @technology_ottomans/field-work-1.webp@ better but more micro)
@age/vizier_point.webp@->@technology_ottomans/military-campus-1.webp@/@technology_ottomans/anatolian-hills-1.webp@ (if not taken before, if no food no map control)
when close to age up, 4 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@->@resource/resource_stone.webp@ then back at 100 @resource/resource_stone.webp@

@landmark_ottomans/mehmed-imperial-armory-2.webp@ either makes @unit_siege/springald.webp@/@unit_siege/mangonel-3.webp@ (@unit_siege/mangonel-3.webp@ against knight civs to kill archers,@unit_siege/springald.webp@ against mass spears)
upgrade unit u have most, can skip @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ upgrade if not enough archers and skip to other unit
Idea is protect @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@ so they do damage
Good switch if have good @resource/resource_gold.webp@ eco, switch to @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@,@building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@->@unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@
Once you have 100 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, move all @resource/resource_stone.png@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@.
Adjust economy to leave 4 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and 8 on @resource/resource_gold.png@.

If you don't have enough @resource/sheep.webp@ to go @age/age_3.png@ get @technology_ottomans/anatolian-hills-1.png@, else get @technology_ottomans/field-work-1.png@, if so, send your @unit_abbasid/imam.png@ to the @resource/relics.png@@resource/relics.png@.
If your being attacked get @technology_ottomans/janissary-company-1.webp@, else get @technology_ottomans/fast-training-1.png@.

name: Beasty Ottoman Fast Castle
author: TyrusLunarspear

notes: When the 5 @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ are done, you will send them to gather from a @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ once, and go to sheep
Next @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.png@ that comes out of TC will build @building_ottomans/military-school-1.png@ then go to @resource/sheep.png@
Remacro and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 12 (you will need to go on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ for a bit)
5 @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ go to @landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.png@ and gather @resource/resource_food.png@, 3 stay on @resource/sheep.png@
Build a @building_military/barracks.png@ placed smartly near @building_ottomans/military-school-1.png@ (you will need to add a @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ later)

@resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@->@building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@Shift back to @resource/sheep.webp@ (Aligned with TC) + (Close to TC 0 Squares in between)

AGE UP COMPLETED PUT 5x@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ on @landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.webp@@resource/berrybush.webp@, INSTA BUILD 2nd @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ with@resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ (Aligned with TC) + (Opposite site of 1st mil school) +  (Close to TC 0 Squares in between)

After Get 3x @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ Get 1 @unit_ottomans/mehter-2.webp@ from @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ after that turn to@unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@

name: Ottoman | FC (with early military school)
author: Jockxtar

notes: If there are @resource/deer.webp@ available and it's safe: @landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.webp@ -> @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@

Keep your @unit_abbasid/imam.webp@ safe in your base until your @age/age_3.webp@ landmark is almost finished, then move them near @resource/relics.webp@ to immediately pick them up once it's completed.
@landmark_ottomans/mehmed-imperial-armory-2.webp@: Is the standard, good in all circumstances, build orders, matchups, maps, team compositions... Always a good choice.

@landmark_ottomans/istanbul-imperial-palace-2.webp@: Is only better in maps where trade is viable or when playing 2TC. That way you can play more greedy, get some free units with @technology_ottomans/janissary-company-1.webp@/@technology_ottomans/great-bombard-vizier.webp@ to defend with and still have some @age/vizier_point.webp@ for the more important upgrades like @technology_ottomans/military-campus-1.webp@, @technology_ottomans/advanced-academy-1.webp@, @technology_ottomans/siege-crews-1.webp@ and @technology_ottomans/trade-bags-1.webp@
Produce 1 @unit_ottomans/mehter-2.webp@ on @building_military/stable.webp@ and then @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@ or @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend

Produce either @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ or @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@ while aging up, but try to keep at least 240 @resource/resource_food.webp@ in reserve to immediately produce @age/age_3.webp@ units upon completing the landmark.
If you have any excess @resource/resource_food.webp@, produce @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@/@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ too.

If enemy has a lot of @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, produce @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ and @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ instead of @unit_ottomans/janissary-3.webp@ and @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@

Once you get 350 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ behind your base to protect future @building_economy/farm.webp@ placements. Ideally you want it near @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Make a big army, fight a lot with your opponent before they can set up their economy and slowly grab @resource/relics.webp@ and capture @resource/sacred_sites.webp@
Our goal now is to slow down the game to get @age/vizier_point.webp@ until our economy is strong enough to go @age/age_4.webp@ comfortably.

*For the 4th @age/vizier_point.webp@, you can choose any upgrade you want, but it's too early to really benefit from @technology_ottomans/siege-crews-1.webp@, so leave that one for last. My recommendations:
- @technology_ottomans/janissary-company-1.webp@ can help you turn around a complicated situation or get an edge over the opponent's army and start a snowball effect.

- @technology_ottomans/pax-ottomana.webp@ on 1 @building_economy/town-center.webp@ is helpful, but not that great. On 2 @building_economy/town-center.webp@ though, it's a massive boost that allows you to reach optimal @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ count just as quickly as if you had started the game with the additional @building_economy/town-center.webp@.
@landmark_ottomans/sea-gate-castle-3.webp@: Only if you desperately need to protect your base from an incoming all-in OR if you are trading (which we are not doing in this guide).
If enemy is not making a lot of @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, also upgrade @unit_ottomans/janissary-3.webp@ to elite and research @technology_ottomans/janissary-guns-4.webp@.
@technology_military/incendiary-arrows.webp@ only if you are making @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ instead of @unit_ottomans/janissary-3.webp@
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Once you have a good bank of resources, you can delete @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ thanks to @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ free units.

Once you are close to max population, gather a lot of @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and do the @building_economy/farm.webp@ transition. You can keep reinforcing your army slowly thanks to @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ and @landmark_ottomans/mehmed-imperial-armory-2.webp@, so the impact should be lower than for other civilizations.
